name: Epic
overview: The topic of 'Epic' in Scripture is exemplified by powerful songs of deliverance and victory, such as those sung by Moses and the children of Israel after crossing the Red Sea. These songs celebrate the LORD's triumphant strength and salvation, portraying Him as a mighty warrior who decisively defeats the enemy by casting Pharaoh's chariots and host into the sea. The vivid imagery of God's right hand dashing the enemy in pieces underscores His glorious power and faithfulness to His people.
